outlet: Infosecurity Italia 2006, Milano - Area Demo IT Security (official Reed Exhibitions programme PDF 'La nuova area demo di IT security')
title: Riservatezza: l'impiego delle tecnologie di firma digitale per la tutela della confidenzialita' (venerdi 10 febbraio, ore 10:00, areademo; Speaker: Fabio Pietrosanti; a cura di sikurezza.org)
note: Official organiser source for the 2006 firma digitale talk (previously known only via SlideShare 1669276 and the sikurezza.org wiki). Read via pdftotext 2026-10-21: 'Speaker: Fabio Pietrosanti / A cura di sikurezza.org'. The same PDF also prints his name (same firma-digitale abstract) under the Thursday 9 Feb 15:00 slot titled 'Modello di sicurezza di Windows - dalla A(CL) alla (Auth)z', evidently a copy-paste error in the programme; the 9 Feb 16:30 PHP hardening slot is credited to Igor Falcomata' (Fabio presented it as substitute, per the known sikurezza wiki item). The area was organised with sikurezza.org and Hacking Team.

title: Accesso alle reti anonime (freenet-it.shtml): page offering SSL/password access to his FreeNET and Entropy anonymity-network proxy nodes
note: Self-published page on his own site (title 'Fabio Pietrosanti ~ Securing the information for fun and profit'); he runs FreeNET and Entropy nodes and offers access via supertolla.itapac.net. Linked from the 'I M H O' news box of the 2005-2006 homepages (naif.itapac.net/index-en.shtml 2005-04-04, fabio.pietrosanti.it/index.shtml 2006-07-21). 10 captures 2005-02-04..2006-12-21, same digest. Early evidence of his anonymity-network work before the hack.lu 2006 Tor hidden-services talk. Low priority: own website, not a third-party mention.
